def solve():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    s = int(input()) - 1
    t = int(input())
    
    while t % n != 0:
        if s < m:
            s = (s + t) % n
        else:
            s = (s - t) % n
            if s < 0:
                s += n
        t -= 1
    
    t //= n
    seen = [-1] * n
    seen[s] = 0
    count = 0
    
    while t > 0:
        t -= 1
        count += 1
        for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            if s < m:
                s = (s + i) % n
            else:
                s = (s - i + n) % n
        if seen[s] != -1:
            cycle_len = count - seen[s]
            if cycle_len > 0:
                t %= cycle_len
        seen[s] = count
    
    print(s + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
